newsitem.title: USA: Pen Interconnect Inc foresees Q4 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Pen Interconnect Inc foresees Q4 shr loss.

text.p: Pen Interconnect Inc said it expects to report a per share loss amid falling sales in the fourth quarter of its 1996 fiscal year, which ends in September.

Pen, which provides custom cable connections, described the downturn in semiconductor and capital equipment sales as "temporary," expecting them to rise again in the first quarter of the next fiscal year.
It reported net sales of $8.6 million for the third quarter, nearly double the $4.7 million reported for the same period the previous year.
Per share income for that period was $0.02 against $0.11.
Pen also said it foresees a loss for 1996 fiscal year as a result of production inefficiencies, one-time expenses and additional costs in absorbing two acquisitions.
It said it was trying to lower its overhead as well as improve is sales by hiring a new sales manager.
